title: Ontario Ministry of Housing Annual Report
description: A bounded reconstruction of three consecutive annual reports with scope-aware, page-linked section alignments.

review.criteria: A valid alignment names the same program, branch, scoped financial note, or equivalent structural section in adjacent volumes. A shared phrase alone is insufficient.

stories.title: Planning grants expand to $1.75 million
stories.summary: The 1975/76 report describes a $1.75 million grant program for municipalities with limited planning resources, an increase of $1.25 million from the previous fiscal year.
stories.why_it_matters: A researcher can find the scale change and verify the language without reading both annual reports end to end.

stories.title: Ontario Housing Action moves beyond its original window
stories.summary: The program appears across all three volumes. The 1975/76 report says it was modified and extended; the following report looks back on its original two-year design.
stories.why_it_matters: Following one named program across the sequence turns isolated reports into a traceable policy history.

stories.title: Rent supplement reporting records 5,899 units
stories.summary: The 1976/77 report records 5,899 private-sector rent-geared-to-income units and says program costs were shared with a federal partner and 48 municipalities.
stories.why_it_matters: The aligned section makes a concrete measure of program scale discoverable from the preceding annual report.

stories.title: Neighborhood improvement carries into the next year
stories.summary: The 1975/76 report records 33 participating municipalities and $15 million in federal allocation. The next volume continues the same program as assistance for older residential neighborhoods.
stories.why_it_matters: The record shows both a dated allocation and the program's continued purpose in the following volume.

stories.title: Equal Opportunity moves from launch to implementation
stories.summary: One report records the program's formal establishment in May 1975. The next describes work on the implementation systems needed to operate it.
stories.why_it_matters: A repeated heading becomes a small administrative timeline instead of another isolated mention.
